bible: Style: 2D stylized noir cartoon with warm watercolor textures, paper cutout lighting, and muted teal and amber tones. Protagonist: Milo, a curious 14-year-old apprentice clockmaker with oversized brass round goggles, messy chestnut hair, and a brown wool vest. Companion: Pip, a silent clockwork ferret made of polished brass with glowing cyan crystal eyes. Setting: Oakhaven, a foggy mountain town filled with towering mechanical clock towers and winding cobblestone streets.

episodes.title: Why Did Every Clock Freeze at 3:17?
episodes.recap: Every clock in Oakhaven mysteriously stops at 3:17, leading Milo and Pip to find a glowing, frozen mechanical moth where the tower pendulum should be.
